ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate approximately 95% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized to small spots and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A continuous field of low-intensity black pixels across the majority of both lobes. High-contrast contiguous blobs are visible as scattered white circular spots (diameter 5-15 pixels) and large, irregular high-intensity clusters at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 40-50 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central halves of both lobes, transitioning to high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular jagged peaks at the lateral distal regions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a broad convex sweep from the notch toward the tips, ending in a sharp upward taper at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent high-contrast pixel clusters appearing as white textured masses (barnacle colonies) are situated on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Sparse white circular spots are distributed across the dark field of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, high-contrast white linear streaks are visible: one prominent oblique scratch on the left lobe and multiple smaller, unaligned horizontal streaks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast barnacle colonization at the lateral tips of both lobes, resulting in significant textural and pixel-intensity disruption to the fluke's perimeter.
